info.text:
In Q3 2026, 57% of UnitedHealth's operating profit didn't come from insurance.
Optum earned $3.7B in earnings from operations vs $2.8B at UnitedHealthcare (our math: 57% of $6.56B). For all of 2025 it was about half ($9.5B of $19.0B).
Optum's revenue grew from $136.3B in 2020 to $270.6B in 2025.
CMS's 80/20 rule makes insurers spend 80-85% of premiums on care; critics note payments to its own doctors and pharmacy business count as care, and their profit isn't capped.
In 2025, about $168B of sales were between UnitedHealth's own businesses. A DOJ antitrust probe of the UnitedHealthcare-Optum link was first reported by the WSJ in Feb 2024.
Sources: UnitedHealth Group FY2025 and Q3 2026 earnings releases (SEC 8-K), CMS, WSJ.
News and education, not financial advice.
